description: Five Oracle database user accounts have been flagged by a security review for excessive privileges. As a Compliance Officer, audit and remediate all five accounts: revoke the DBA role from DEV_USER, revoke CREATE TABLE and SELECT ANY TABLE from REPORT_USER2, revoke RESOURCE and UNLIMITED TABLESPACE from APP_USER, lock LEGACY_USER, and leave ANALYST_USER with only CREATE SESSION and CREATE VIEW. Then create and enable an Oracle Unified Audit policy named PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION_AUDIT covering GRANT ANY PRIVILEGE, CREATE USER, DROP USER, ALTER USER, and CREATE ROLE. Finally export a security remediation report to /home/ga/Documents/exports/security_remediation.txt documenting what was found and fixed for each account.
